Connect the tenant
==================

Ask anna@contoso.com to approve the request. Notifications are sent from no-reply@omniacloud.net.

Open https://contoso.sharepoint.com/sites/intranet and https://contoso-admin.sharepoint.com, or
https://[yourtenantname]-admin.sharepoint.com for your own tenant.

Omnia runs at https://contoso.omniacloud.net and signs in through https://auth.omniacloud.net.

Microsoft Graph has the application id 00000003-0000-0000-c000-000000000000.

Use an address from the documentation range, for example 192.0.2.10.

The source of this documentation is https://github.com/omniaintranet/OmniaDocsG2.

- Search now returns results for long queries (#59036)
- Document Bulk Update handles large libraries (#59558, #166490)

Colours in a sample style sheet are not references:

.. code-block:: css

   .title { color: #333; }

.. vale off

Write the address as admin@customer.com only in this quoted example.

.. vale on
